title: AIFlowBridge Model Registry
description: Schema for the AIFlowBridge bundled model registry and its overrides. Lives in three tiers: bundled (resources/models.json) < globalStorage (<globalStorageUri>/models.json) < workspace (.vscode/aiflowbridge.models.json). Higher tiers override lower tiers per model id and per vendor key. The schema is referenced from models.json via the $schema property for editor autocompletion.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema. Lets VS Code provide autocompletion and validation while editing the file.

version.description: Registry file format version. Currently always 1.

vendors.description: Map of vendor config key (e.g. 'deepseek') to its upstream connection settings and external URLs. The key must match a `ModelDefinition.family` value used by the models in this file. Keys are free-form; adding a new vendor does not require a schema change.

models.description: List of model definitions exposed by this registry tier.

vendor.description: A vendor (upstream provider) and its connection settings.

baseUrl.description: Default upstream API base URL used when the user has not overridden it via aiflowbridge.providers.<vendor>.baseUrl.

apiKeySecret.description: VS Code SecretStorage key holding the API key for this vendor. Read via the SecretStorage API, never written to settings.json.

externalUrls.description: Links to the vendor's web console (API key management, usage, status pages, regional endpoints). Keys are free-form; consumers look them up by name.

model.description: A single model definition. The `id` is the upstream API id (sent verbatim in the `model` field of the request body). The `name` is the human-readable label shown in the Copilot Chat picker.

id.description: Upstream API model id. Must match exactly what the vendor's /v1/models endpoint returns.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the Copilot Chat model picker.

family.description: Vendor config key. Must match a key in the `vendors` map of this registry (deepseek, minimax, xiaomi, openrouter, antigravity, or googleaistudio).

version.description: Free-form version label (e.g. 'v4', 'm2.5', 'v2.5-pro'). Not interpreted by the code, used for display and filtering only.

detail.description: Short marketing description shown in the Copilot Chat picker.

maxInputTokens.description: Maximum number of input tokens the model accepts (context window).

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens the model can generate in a single response.

capabilities.description: Capability flags advertised to VS Code. `toolCalling` is a number (max parallel tool calls) for DeepSeek, a boolean for other vendors.

toolCalling.description: Tool calling support. `true` = unlimited, a positive integer = max parallel tool calls (DeepSeek currently advertises 128).

imageInput.description: Whether the model accepts image inputs. The vision proxy transparently converts images to text descriptions for models that do not.

thinking.description: Whether the model exposes a 'thinking' / reasoning mode in the picker.

requiresThinkingParam.description: Whether the upstream API requires a `thinking` parameter on every request (DeepSeek). When false, the parameter is omitted unless the user opts in.

pricing.description: Indicative token-plan tariff. Used by the dashboard's 'Est. cost' column. Override per-profile via aiflowbridge.providers[].pricing.
